stem.text: A student was asked to use the scale bar shown to calculate the magnification of a cell on a photomicrograph.
Which method could the student use to calculate the magnification of the cell?

A.text: divide the diameter of the cell by the length of the scale bar, with both measured in the same units of length

B.text: measure the diameter of the cell in millimetres, multiply by 2000 and divide by the length of the scale bar measured in millimetres

C.text: measure the length of the scale bar in millimetres, convert to micrometres and divide by 2

D.text: measure the length of the scale bar in millimetres, convert to micrometres and multiply by 2
